title: Kiku lesson
description: Contract between the Kiku API and clients. Mirrored by backend/app/schemas.py and android/.../data/remote/KikuApi.kt; change all three together.

clip_id.description: Content hash of the subtitle text. Identical subtitles always produce the same id, which is what makes lessons cacheable.

level.description: Estimated JLPT level of the clip, from the level at which 80% of its vocabulary is covered.

new_words.description: Teachable words the learner has not saved yet.

comprehension_estimate.description: Percentage of tokens the learner already knows. Used to warn when a clip is too hard.

start_ms.description: Timestamp in the original clip, so the player can seek to this line.

romaji.description: Modified Hepburn: doubled consonants for sokuon, lengthened vowels for chouonpu, apostrophe after syllabic n.

note.description: Sentence-level grammar or register note, when there is something worth saying.

word_chip.description: One tappable token. Concatenating surfaces in order reproduces the line exactly.

surface.description: The form as it appears on screen.

lemma.description: Dictionary form. Review scheduling is keyed on this, so all inflections of a verb share one card.

note.description: Why this form: conjugation path, nuance, or politeness level.

teachable.description: False for punctuation and symbols, which must not be tappable or saveable.
